title: dev/audit/README.md: the mock-use claim is false and the j5_gil reviewer pointer is stale
claim: dev/audit/README.md says tests/optimality.py is the only unittest.mock use in the suite and that `briefs/fix-review.md` section 9 sends a fix reviewer to j5_gil.py; five suite scripts import unittest.mock and no fix-review contract names j5_gil.py.
